limitations: Full P01-P16 objective incomplete; 130 available cases not all rerun.

The migration limit screenshot records retained form after toast dismissal; actual transient text was verified by browser-frame predicate, not a screenshot of the error. Complete toast timing and visual fidelity remain pending.
P08 roles/concurrency/remaining boundaries/recovery/visuals, P07 leftovers and P09-P16 remain.
